NATIONAL MERIT SCHOLARSHIP 2026
Notice No. NMS/2026/01. Date: 10 January 2026.
Issuing Authority: Ministry of Education & National Scholarship Board, New Delhi.
Subject: National Merit Scholarship Scheme for Higher Technical & Professional Education 2026-27.

1. Eligibility Criteria:
Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Science or Engineering with a minimum 65% aggregate marks from a recognized university.
Age Limit: Candidate must not exceed 25 years as of 01-08-2026. A 3-year relaxation applies for OBC candidates, and 5-year relaxation for SC/ST candidates.

2. Important Deadlines:
Online application submission commences on 15 January 2026.
The last date for online submission of applications is 15 February 2026, 5:00 PM.
Late submissions will not be entertained under any circumstances.

3. Application Fees & Payment:
Application fee is ₹500 for General and OBC category applicants.
SC, ST, and PwD applicants are fully exempted from payment of fees.

4. Mandatory Documents:
Applicants must upload Self-Attested Marksheets, Degree Certificate, Valid Caste Certificate (if applicable), and Domicile Certificate.

5. Helpline & Contact:
National Scholarship Portal Helpdesk: helpdesk@scholarships.gov.in | Phone: 011-23386000.
